name: torquelock-ar
description: TorqueLock AR — Spatial Memory and Procedural Training Coach for Snap SPECS

scripts.preview: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let raw=req.url.split('?')[0].replace(/^\//,''); const targets=(!raw||raw==='')?['preview/index.html','index.html']:[raw,path.join('preview',raw),path.join('preview',path.basename(raw))]; const found=targets.find(t=>fs.existsSync(t)&&fs.statSync(t).isFile()); if(!found){ res.writeHead(404,{'Content-Type':'text/plain'}); return res.end('Not found: '+req.url); } const ext=path.extname(found).slice(1).toLowerCase(); const ct={'html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','js':'application/javascript; charset=utf-8','css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','json':'application/json','png':'image/png','svg':'image/svg+xml','mp4':'video/mp4'}[ext]||'text/plain'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':ct,'Cache-Control':'no-cache'}); fs.createReadStream(found).pipe(res); }); server.listen(8080,()=>console.log('TorqueLock AR SPECS Preview running at http://localhost:8080/'));"

author: Devpost Learn SPECS Hackathon Team
